inspection: Full extracted text read for both guides; all four Custom Documents pages additionally rendered and visually inspected headlessly.
scoped_facts: Quick Reference filename says 2023-02 but its printed header says last updated July 26, 2022; current deployment/version applicability is not established.
Quick Reference identifies Agenda Managers as the UI role that creates meetings. Import Agenda Items selects and copies items from another meeting; it is not an external file-import contract.
Custom Agenda, Public Notice and Minutes documents are static and require replacement after meeting changes.
Custom document upload does not itself change MeetingStatus; public visibility has separate status, permission and download conditions.
Two Word variants, text, HTML and PDF are report output options. Screenshots show an RTF custom document example; neither establishes an exhaustive input schema or machine integration contract.
limitations: Historical UI documentation; no machine API route, request/response payload, external file import schema, acknowledgement, readback or conflict semantics established.
UI Agenda Manager role does not establish machine integration permission or enablement.
No API-absence or outside-only dependency conclusion.
